component: Exchange channel and offline stream listener ownership

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The historical fix clears the channel’s stored stream listener after the offline helper accepts the asynchronous read. The wrapper releases its channel after forwarding OnStopRequest and applying failed-offline-message policy. These are different lifetime boundaries; the public channel remains the request object while callbacks need it. Breaking one cycle edge is sufficient for the reported pair, so clearing both is not a universal policy. Later accepted Exchange code passes a listener argument directly instead of keeping the historical member. No leak, destruction, cancellation or callback test was run.
title: Offline-read ownership clears references after handoff and after the final callback
